summary.text: Mike Bohacek is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 8, which covers Starke County and portions of LaPorte, Marshall and St. Joseph counties, since 2016.
He serves on the Health and Provider Services and Local Government committees.

paragraphs.text: According to his Indiana Senate Republican biography, Bohacek earned B.S. degrees in finance and in economics from DePaul University and served two terms as a LaPorte County Commissioner.
He is an enterprise consultant for Echo Global Logistics and owner of MSL Services Inc. in Michiana Shores.
The page lists his family as his wife, Melissa, and three daughters, Lisa, Lucy and Stephanie.
